ember.name: Ember
ember.description: Raw fire: big hits, burning ground, a hex that makes everything burn hotter.

frost.name: Frost
frost.description: Control and protection: chill, freeze, hail and shells of ice.

storm.name: Storm
storm.description: Wild damage that jumps between foes, shocks them and keeps arcing on its own.

cinder.name: Cinder
cinder.description: Burning steel: wide cuts that set foes alight, fissures of fire, a roar that ignites the pack.

rime.name: Rime
rime.description: A wall of ice: cleaves that chill, a shield that freezes, blows that shatter frozen foes.

thunder.name: Thunder
thunder.description: Violet thunder: leaps into the pack, hurled hammers that jump, a storm that circles him.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: Hurls a ball of fire at one enemy. Fire hits have a chance to burn.

mods.name: Searing Core
mods.text: +40% chance to burn, 30% more burn damage.

mods.name: Bursting Core
mods.text: Explodes on impact: 60% damage to enemies within 1.4 tiles.

mods.name: Cinder Trail
mods.text: Leaves burning ground for 2.5s where it lands (25% damage per pulse).

pyromancy.name: Pyromancy
pyromancy.description: Passive. +8% fire damage and +6% burn damage per level.

searing.name: Searing Burst
searing.description: Flames erupt around the target and hit every enemy within 1.8 tiles. +30% chance to burn.

mods.name: Afterburn
mods.text: Leaves burning ground for 3s (25% damage per pulse).

mods.name: Kindle
mods.text: +50% chance to burn, burns last 1s longer.

mods.name: Double Burst
mods.text: Erupts a second time 0.4s later (60% damage).

mods.name: Chain Eruption
mods.text: Enemies it kills explode for 25% of their life as fire damage.

flamelance.name: Flame Lance
flamelance.description: Channels a lance of fire for about a second. Each of its 5 pulses burns every enemy on the line to the target.

mods.name: Scorch
mods.text: +40% chance to burn, 25% more burn damage.

mods.name: Forked Lance
mods.text: Each pulse also burns 1 more enemy near the target.

mods.name: Flare
mods.text: Each pulse bursts around the target: 30% damage within 1.2 tiles.

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.description: Calls a meteor onto the target. Hits everything within 2.5 tiles and always burns.

mods.name: Molten Crater
mods.text: Leaves burning ground for 3s (30% damage per pulse).

mods.name: Falling Star
mods.text: 1 more meteor lands on another enemy (50% damage).

mods.name: Aftershock
mods.text: The ground shakes again 0.4s later (40% damage).

mods.name: Meteor Shower
mods.text: 2 more meteors on other enemies (50% damage).

mods.name: Cataclysm
mods.text: 20% larger area, 30% more damage, 30% more mana.

ashenhex.name: Ashen Hex
ashenhex.description: Hexes enemies within 2.6 tiles of the target for 8s: they take 15% more fire damage (+1.5% per level), burn included.

mods.name: Hex of Ruin
mods.text: Also raises cold and lightning damage taken by half the value.

mods.name: Contagion
mods.text: When a hexed enemy dies, the hex jumps to enemies within 2.5 tiles.

mods.name: Choking Ash
mods.text: Hexed enemies move and attack 20% slower.

mods.name: Pyre
mods.text: Hexed enemies explode on death for 30% of their life as fire damage.

mods.name: Doom
mods.text: The hex is 40% stronger but lasts 30% shorter.

kindling.name: Kindling
kindling.description: Passive. +4% chance to burn and 2% fire penetration per level.

smoulder.name: Smoulder
smoulder.description: Passive. +4% damage against burning enemies and +2% chance to burn per level.

frostbolt.name: Frost Bolt
frostbolt.description: Cheap bolt. Chills strongly for 3s: chilled enemies move and attack slower.

mods.name: Frost Burst
mods.text: Shatters on impact: 50% damage to enemies within 1.3 tiles.

mods.name: Splinter
mods.text: Splits into 2 on its first hit, 10% less damage.

mods.name: Rime Patch
mods.text: Leaves freezing ground for 2s (20% damage per pulse).

coldmastery.name: Cold Mastery
coldmastery.description: Passive. +8% cold damage and +2% chill effect per level.

frostarmor.name: Frost Armor
frostarmor.description: Adds 6 + 6 per level barrier for 30s. Melee attackers get chilled.

mods.name: Cold Grip

mods.name: Shatter Armor

mods.name: Frost Aura

icenova.name: Ice Nova
icenova.description: A ring of ice bursts from the sorceress, hitting all enemies within 3.2 tiles. +15% chance to freeze.

mods.name: Twin Ring

mods.name: Shatter
mods.text: Enemies it kills burst for 25% of their life as cold damage.

hailstorm.name: Hailstorm

mods.name: Twin Storms

rimeshell.name: Rime Shell
rimeshell.description: Emergency shell of ice: barrier worth 20% of life (+1% per level), 30% less damage taken for 4s, and enemies within 2.6 tiles freeze.

mods.name: Frost Burst

mods.name: Hard Shell
mods.text: 20% less damage taken on top while it lasts.

mods.name: Bulwark
mods.text: +25% of life as barrier, 15% shorter cooldown.

permafrost.name: Permafrost
permafrost.description: Passive. +3% chance to freeze and 2% cold penetration per level.

brittlefrost.name: Brittle Frost
brittlefrost.description: Passive. +3% damage against chilled or frozen enemies and 4% longer freezes per level.

chain.name: Chain Lightning
chain.description: Arcs through up to 3 enemies close to each other, 15% weaker per jump.

mods.name: True Arc
mods.text: Loses only 5% per jump instead of 15%.

mods.name: Thunderous
mods.text: Each target is blasted: 40% damage to enemies within 1.2 tiles.

conductivity.name: Conductivity
conductivity.description: Passive. +4% chance to shock and +3% shock effect per level.

nova.name: Static Nova
nova.description: Shocks every enemy within 4 tiles. +20% chance to shock.

mods.name: Pulse
mods.text: Pulses a second time 0.4s later (60% damage).

mods.name: Static Ground
mods.text: Leaves crackling ground for 3s (15% damage per pulse).

mods.name: Tempest
mods.text: Pulses two more times (40% damage each).

thunder.name: Thunderstrike

mods.name: Forked Sky

mods.name: Sky Fury
mods.text: 2 more bolts on other enemies (50% damage).

stormlantern.description: Lights a lantern of violet storm that floats beside her for 12s and strikes the nearest enemy within 5.5 tiles every 0.9s.

mods.name: Arcing Light
mods.text: Each strike jumps to 2 more enemies.

mods.name: Lantern Choir

stormmastery.name: Storm Mastery

mods.name: Pyre Blast
